preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 200,000.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1, as it is a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid vertices and must not connect a vertex to itself.

postconditions.description: The number of transformations k must be between 0 and 2n.
Each transformation must consist of exactly three integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and 1 <= y_prime <= n for x, y, y_prime in transformations)
postconditions.description: All vertices in the transformations must be valid indices within the range of vertices.
